purpose: Add Abide with Me with source-traceable public-domain text, a CC0 playable MIDI arrangement, and presentation-ready stanza text.
guardrails: Lyrics were transcribed line by line from the cited 1927 hymnal record without modernization or correction.
Hymnary identifies both Henry F. Lyte's text and William Henry Monk's EVENTIDE tune as public domain.
The MIDI setting is retained from the exact Wikimedia Commons file page under its CC0 dedication.
The MIDI and machine-readable Wikimedia license metadata are verified by SHA-256.
No historical or modern performance recording is included or implied to be reusable.

entries.title: Abide with Me
entries.text_source_edition: Hymnal for Church and Home, 1927, hymn 52
entries.presentation_use: Five exact-source stanza slides and a title slide linked to KJV Scripture references.
entries.recording_scope: The in-app Web Audio playback is synthesized from the retained CC0 MIDI. No third-party performance recording is copied.
